title: gold_canonical.user_permissions
description: Canonical Gold — resolved effective RBAC state per (tenant, user): active roles, flattened permissions, and active project membership. One document per (tenantId, user_uid). Cross-feature: consumed by Eden first, intended for any future feature needing RBAC instead of re-deriving the same Silver joins. Schema mirrors gold/src/canonical/load_user_permissions.py shape_doc() exactly. Source model verified in docs/canonical/user_access_management_model.md: source table is silver.roles (NOT silver.role); project access is mediated through silver.resource (project_member has no direct user_id) so users without a resource row cannot appear in project_ids.
x-etl-trigger: batch rebuild via --rebuild; real-time CDC streaming recommended follow-up given RBAC revocation latency sensitivity (see docs/canonical/user_access_management_model.md)

_env.description: Deployment tier that wrote this doc (PIPELINE_ENV) — different axis from sourceEnv.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier. Part of the compound upsert key.

user_uid.description: silver.user_account.object_id — the external IdP id, matches the JWT `oid` claim. Grain key. Rows with a NULL object_id are skipped by the loader (cannot be keyed).

user_account_id.description: silver.user_account.id — internal tenant-scoped FK used for joins.

isActive.description: user_account.active AND NOT user_account.deleted. Does not fold in _s_is_deleted — that is surfaced separately as isDeleted per platform convention.

roles.description: Distinct silver.roles.name for effective (temporally valid, active-role) user_role_map assignments. Source table is `roles`, not `role`.

permissions.description: Distinct silver.role_permission.permission codes ('RESOURCE.ACTION' form, e.g. DOC.MAN) flattened across effective roles. No permission master table exists source-side — codes are uncatalogued free text.

project_ids.description: silver.project_member.project_id (cast to string) WHERE status='ACTIVE', resolved via the resource bridge (user_account -> resource -> project_member). Users with no silver.resource row will have an empty array even if they hold roles/permissions.

_silverLsn.description: Max PostgreSQL LSN across contributing rows at write time. Upsert guard.
